entities.name: Thomas Claiborne
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas Claiborne was an American Democratic-Republican politician and son of Virginia Congressman Thomas B. Claiborne, who continued the family's political and planter traditions and served in the United States House of Representatives for the state of Tennessee.
